name: Egregore
description: Deeper initiation into the Mysterium's communal egregore. Each dot unlocks the corresponding ritual or Order benefit.
descriptionEn: Deeper initiation into the Mysterium's communal egregore. Each dot unlocks the corresponding ritual or Order benefit.

levels.name: Mysteriorum Arche
levels.description: In teamwork spellcasting, contribute without the usual penalty when lacking the required Arcanum and add one automatic success when participating fully. Every member of the ritual team must possess this Merit.

levels.name: Mysteriorum Anima
levels.description: The character's full Mysterium Status applies in every Mysterium Caucus, rather than only her local Caucus.

levels.name: Mysteriorum Barathrum
levels.description: Use Libraries belonging to the cabal or Mysterium Caucus without physical access. Once per chapter, gain Informed regarding the local Mysterium's members, specialties, Merits, Obsessions, and Arcana.

levels.name: Mysteriorum Calamitas
levels.description: The first magical tool used in a spell counts as a Dedicated Magical Tool.

levels.name: Mysteriorum Focus
levels.description: While in an Order Sanctum, the character has a Medium sympathetic connection to every member of the Order.

name: Masque
description: A Guardian persona assumed by spending Willpower. Willpower cannot be regained while the Masque is maintained, and shedding it takes one minute. Additional Masques cost two dots each and inherit the primary Masque's level.
descriptionEn: A Guardian persona assumed by spending Willpower. Willpower cannot be regained while the Masque is maintained, and shedding it takes one minute. Additional Masques cost two dots each and inherit the primary Masque's level.

levels.name: Identity
levels.description: Choose a different Virtue and Vice and use them while the Masque is active.

levels.name: Competency
levels.description: Choose Skill Specialties equal to the primary Masque's rating and use them instead of the character's own while the Masque is active.

levels.name: Diffusion
levels.description: Choose a Signature Nimbus used in place of the character's own while the Masque is active.

levels.name: The Code
levels.description: Choose two Acts of Hubris for which the character does not risk Wisdom while the Masque is active.

levels.name: Immersion
levels.description: Choose up to five dots of Merits that logically belong to the identity. They are available while the Masque is active and cannot include further Masques.

name: Prelacy
description: The Seer invites a patron Exarch into her soul. Commands from the Exarch must be pursued before other Obsessions can provide Arcane Beats in the same chapter.
descriptionEn: The Seer invites a patron Exarch into her soul. Commands from the Exarch must be pursued before other Obsessions can provide Arcane Beats in the same chapter.

levels.name: Chosen Vessel
levels.description: Gain the Persistent Mystery Commands Condition.

levels.name: Sword
levels.description: Use the patron Exarch's symbolism as a patron Yantra worth half the character's Prelacy dots, rounded up.

levels.name: Crown
levels.description: Gain the Crown Attainment associated with the patron Exarch.

levels.name: Temple
levels.description: A Demesne incorporating one of the character's soul stones becomes a Supernal Verge keyed to her Exarch. Soul stones belonging to incompatible Exarchs collapse the Temple and are destroyed.

name: Profane Tool
description: Choose Scepters, Robes, Crowns, Thrones, or Rings. The character may use and Dedicate the chosen Profane Form as though it were a Path tool. Purchase separately for each form.
descriptionEn: Choose Scepters, Robes, Crowns, Thrones, or Rings. The character may use and Dedicate the chosen Profane Form as though it were a Path tool. Purchase separately for each form.

name: Faction Member
description: Membership in a Pentacle faction. Heretical factions grant +2 effective Status among local faction members but impose −2 Status with other members of the Order; this can raise effective Status above five.
descriptionEn: Membership in a Pentacle faction. Heretical factions grant +2 effective Status among local faction members but impose −2 Status with other members of the Order; this can raise effective Status above five.

levels.name: Faction Status
levels.description: Gain +1 effective Status with faction members in the local Caucus. Outside the Caucus, Faction Member dots act as Status with faction members, including members of other Orders in a cross-Order faction.

levels.name: Faction Tool
levels.description: Gain the faction's additional Order tool Yantra.

levels.name: Faction Rote Skill
levels.description: Gain the faction's fourth Rote Skill.

name: Svikiro
description: A Shona medium who cannot suffer the Claimed Condition and may purchase Social Merits representing relationships with ephemeral entities. Choose wamasikati or wedzinza, each with distinct sensing, communication, and Manifestation benefits.
descriptionEn: A Shona medium who cannot suffer the Claimed Condition and may purchase Social Merits representing relationships with ephemeral entities. Choose wamasikati or wedzinza, each with distinct sensing, communication, and Manifestation benefits.

name: Svikiro Channel
description: While Fettered, communicate with the attached entity and permit it to use Numina or Influences on a chosen target within five yards.
descriptionEn: While Fettered, communicate with the attached entity and permit it to use Numina or Influences on a chosen target within five yards.

levels.name: Channel
levels.description: Communicate with the Fettered entity and permit, but do not compel, its Numina or Influences against a chosen target within five yards.

levels.name: Compel
levels.description: Spend Willpower and win Resolve + Composure contested by Rank + Resistance to compel a Numen or Influence. The entity cannot be forced to violate its Ban or approach its Bane.

name: Svikiro Ridden
description: Remain aware while Possessed, communicate telepathically with the possessing entity, and cooperate so it avoids the usual penalties for acting through the medium's body.
descriptionEn: Remain aware while Possessed, communicate telepathically with the possessing entity, and cooperate so it avoids the usual penalties for acting through the medium's body.

levels.name: Aware
levels.description: Remain aware and communicate with the possessing entity. If the medium cooperates, the entity suffers none of the usual penalties for actions using the body.

levels.name: Control
levels.description: Spend Willpower and win Resolve + Composure contested by Rank + Resistance to control the possessor for the scene. Control ends if Possession succeeds again or the medium contacts the entity's Bane; the entity cannot be forced to violate its nature, Ban, or Bane.

name: Svikiro Nganga
description: The medium receives the benefits of both the wamasikati and wedzinza forms of Svikiro.
descriptionEn: The medium receives the benefits of both the wamasikati and wedzinza forms of Svikiro.
